knowledge_file.description: the user's own pixellab.kapu: PixelLab documentation, REST API v2 reference, MCP tools, Python SDK and transcripts of linked videos; third-party text, not published

scenario: amateur indie team building a top-down game with a dog hero; 12 requests, 9 in Hungarian and 3 in English
agents: 4 Claude Sonnet agents, 3 requests each, only through tools/kapu_mcp_call.py (real MCP, kapu_write not allowed)
judge: independent Claude Sonnet agent; opened every cited door, split each answer into claims and checked each against the source text
notes: Every search query was written in English, also for the 9 Hungarian requests: the agent translated to the content language itself.
The partly correct answer (p12) is a reading error: the opened door states how many objects one call returns, the agent missed it.
Search latency is high (median 1.3 s) because the wrapper starts a new server, and loads the vector model, for every call.
